prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: scene 7 of an eight-scene bridge in the existing BARCODE System Override game, new full-bleed cinematic comic painting.
Primary request: IGNITION / ORIGINAL LOADED. Inside Cache Back's yellow 1980s cyberpunk hatchback at night, viewed from the passenger seat looking diagonally toward the driver. Cache sits LEFT in the driver's seat, one hand on the steering wheel, the other carefully sliding the protected chunky black archive cassette from reference 1 into a physical dashboard archive deck. A wide dark beveled digital dashboard glows restrained mint and amber. High on the windshield a narrow rearview shows just Cache's eyes and cap reflected accurately, with softly blurred studio lights behind him. Outside windshield ahead: wet avenue, cyan and plum night city, warm streetlamps, ready to leave. Car is at rest, no motion blur.
Input images: Image 1 is reference for Cache's exact identity, clothing and original archive cartridge plus established graphic novel rendering. Image 2 is supporting identity reference ONLY for his eyes/eyebrows/glasses/mask and hat; DO NOT draw a grid or multiple heads. Image 3 is the new approved dashboard bezel design reference, adapt naturally into a physical cockpit not a pasted UI panel.
Identity: adult human man brown irises visible through CLEAR black rectangular glasses, short dark hair, yellow cap with two small rounded ear-like protrusions, black angular tech mask covering mouth and nose, dark mechanical collar with small cyan edges. Yellow short-sleeve shirt with black Greek-key trim. No unmasking, no 6 Bit face paint, no helmet replacing his hat.
Style: match reference 1 premium hand-inked mature 1990s cyberpunk graphic novel, confident black ink contours, angular cel shading, subtle halftone and paper grain, deep plum/navy shadows, warm amber, cyan accents. No photorealism, 3D or anime redesign.
Composition: panoramic WIDE 2.2:1, about 1860 by 845. One coherent image without panels or gutters. Driver's head in left upper-middle, tape insertion visible center-lower, road and windshield on right. Complete natural arms and five-finger hands, no fused hands/controls. Nothing important hugs canvas border; bottom 15% low detail.
Text: no readable text, no speech balloons, no captions, no titles, no watermarks. Only abstract illuminated segments on dashboard (runtime lettering is added separately). Keep exact established character and cartridge design.
